keyPoints.en: Primary (from nature), secondary (manufacturing), tertiary (services). One product can pass through all three.
keyPoints.bm: Primer (daripada alam), sekunder (pembuatan), tertier (perkhidmatan). Satu produk boleh melalui ketiga-tiganya.

keyPoints.en: Padi: MADA (Kedah/Perlis), KADA, Kerian, Sekinchan. Oil palm: Sarawak, Sabah, Pahang, Johor. Electronics: Bayan Lepas, Klang Valley. Petroleum: Kerteh, Bintulu, Miri. Tourism: Langkawi, Melaka, George Town.
keyPoints.bm: Padi: MADA (Kedah/Perlis), KADA, Kerian, Sekinchan. Kelapa sawit: Sarawak, Sabah, Pahang, Johor. Elektronik: Bayan Lepas, Lembah Klang. Petroleum: Kerteh, Bintulu, Miri. Pelancongan: Langkawi, Melaka, George Town.

keyPoints.en: Physical: relief, soil, climate, resources. Human: labour, capital, market, transport, technology, government policy.
keyPoints.bm: Fizikal: bentuk muka bumi, tanih, iklim, sumber. Manusia: buruh, modal, pasaran, pengangkutan, teknologi, dasar kerajaan.

keyPoints.en: Jobs, income, foreign exchange, infrastructure development and a higher standard of living.
keyPoints.bm: Pekerjaan, pendapatan, pertukaran wang asing, pembangunan infrastruktur dan taraf hidup lebih tinggi.
